description: This file defines the main application component for a Career Navigator web app built with React and Next.js. It manages states related to uploading documents, generating AI-driven personas, and displaying the progression through different steps (upload, validation, finalization). It includes UI elements like headers, upload interfaces, progress indicators, and state-dependent views. It also handles API interactions for document uploads, persona generation, and orchestration status polling. The component maintains complex internal state to support user interactions, asynchronous API calls, and dynamic rendering.

methods.name: asStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a string array, filtering out non-strings and empty strings.

methods.name: isNonEmptyObject
methods.description: Checks if a value is a non-null object with at least one key.

methods.name: getInitials
methods.description: Returns initials (up to two characters) from a string, used for avatar display.

methods.name: getNestedOrchestrationValue
methods.description: Safely accesses nested values within an object based on a path array, returning value and path used.

methods.name: logAvailableKeys
methods.description: Logs the keys of an object (and its artifacts/output nested objects) for debugging purposes.

methods.name: extractPersonaJsonFromOrchestrationRecord
methods.description: Extracts persona JSON data from an orchestration record, prioritizing specific artifact paths and shape detection.

methods.name: coercePersonaDataFromBackendJson
methods.description: Transforms backend persona JSON into the UI's internal PersonaData shape, supporting multiple backend schemas.

methods.name: fingerprintPersonaData
methods.description: Creates a fingerprint string for PersonaData to detect changes.

methods.name: fingerprintPersonaArtifact
methods.description: Creates a fingerprint for persona JSON artifacts to detect if artifacts have changed.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React component managing the app's state, UI rendering, and interactions for document upload, persona generation, and display. Handles complex state logic, API calls, and rendering of various UI states.
